question: Manoj starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km, then turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Manoj starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km, then turns right and drives 13 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8f509ffa693073f56d29cabaa0ddfafd97a158478e8a89959279634e40ad94f.png] 

So, He should drive **5 km to the west** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
